title: Give the comparison room to be read
subtitle: A common-dimension table carries the comparison. Main commentary and supporting notes remain separate. This sample makes no purchasing recommendation.

blocks.source: Illustrative fixture — synthetic values for layout review only.

blocks.title: Use the main column for the explanation
paragraphs: The main column follows the existing argument. The supporting column holds definitions, limitations, or supplied notes without becoming a second stream of continuous prose.
A comparison matrix needs enough width for each cell to wrap naturally. More rows should create more document space; smaller text should not be the default response.
Keep each criterion as supplied. This layout does not assign weights, calculate scores, or invent a recommended option.

blocks.title: A note belongs beside its subject
blocks.text: Definitions and conditions can sit here when they support the adjacent explanation.
